changes.title: World seed
items: Each campaign has its own world: its islands keep their shapes night after night, while the forest, scenery, animals and legends on them change each night
The sea chart shows your world's seed to share; Start over begins a new world, random or from a seed you type in (or add ?world= to the link)

changes.title: Floor island sigils
items: The dancefloor only draws the sigils of animals that live on this island, and the World Tree joins its shapes
On an animal's own island, the boot writes that animal's sigil on the dancefloor (home's is still the World Tree)

changes.title: All islands
items: The sea chart shows all 64 islands from the start; only the ones you can sail to carry a sigil (wake a legend to find its island)
Islands whose creatures aren't designed yet are on it too, not yet charted
